## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No private keys, seed phrases, credentials, or captured user data are included
- [ ] Fake signing remains explicit, or security-model changes are justified
- [ ] Freighter compatibility claims identify the verified version/source
